text_description: Full-length runway look built in warm autumnal layers: a cropped peach-pink chunky ribbed knit top sits over a darker long-sleeve layer, with a rounded high crew neckline, dropped/rounded shoulder line, short rolled sleeves, and a compact boxy body ending at the waist. Beneath it, a dark brown to bronze textured, semi-sheer-looking knit or mesh layer is visible at the neck, arms, and below the crop, forming a close high collar, long slightly blouson sleeves, fitted cuffs, and a hip-length hem with a nubby speckled surface. A narrow dark horizontal belt or waistband cinches the waist between the upper layers and the skirt, with a small peach ribbed band or peplum-like edge visible just below it. The bottom is a deep plum/aubergine midi skirt with a smooth, softly structured A-line silhouette, falling from the waist to mid-calf with gentle flare, panel-like shaping, and subtle surface sheen. Styling is completed with dark brown tall boots with a squared toe, slim heel, and softly ruched shafts rising under the skirt, plus sculptural gold earrings; the overall mood is layered, textured, and fall-toned, mixing cozy knit volume with a fluid dark midi proportion.
key_elements: cropped peach ribbed knit short-sleeve top
uncertainty_notes: The dark waist element appears to be a belt or waistband but its construction is not fully visible.
The underlayer appears semi-sheer or open-textured from the image, but the exact material is unclear.
